first_public_date_evidence: 2009-10-15 is the earliest verified day-specific initial public posting of cited supporting preprint arXiv:0910.2907v1. An earlier August 1983 journal article is cited but its exact first public day was not established; the 2009 date is not asserted to be the historical first publication.
integrity: Mathematical argument and independently rerunnable finite consistency checker supplied; the review is same-model only, not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed exponents d coprime to 5 only; earlier Erlebach-Velez (1983) index-progression equidistribution is an essential precursor. Exact priority against all implicit consequences is not independently established. Finite checker tests are not infinite proof.
title: Exact five-adic residue spectra of tame power-index Fibonacci subsequences
